settings.question: How long does shipping and delivery take?
settings.answer: All orders are freshly packed and dispatched within 1–2 business days. Standard insulated shipping takes 2–4 business days. Tracking details are automatically emailed upon dispatch.

settings.question: What is your 30-Day Return & Freshness Guarantee?
settings.answer: We stand behind our craft with a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee. If your chocolate arrives melted, damaged, or you are not completely delighted with your order within 30 days, contact our support team for an immediate replacement or full refund.

settings.question: How do you protect chocolate from melting during transit?
settings.answer: We use custom temperature-regulated thermal wrap and food-safe cool packs during warmer months to ensure your artisanal chocolate arrives in perfect, pristine condition.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay. All transactions are protected with bank-grade 256-bit SSL encryption.

settings.question: Are your chocolates organic, vegan, or gluten-free?
settings.answer: Our dark chocolate selections are 100% plant-based, dairy-free, and crafted from certified organic, ethically sourced single-origin cacao. Detailed allergen and ingredient lists are available on every product page.

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subtitle: Clear, honest answers regarding shipping, ingredients, and our 100% freshness guarantee.
